solutionSql:
SELECT s.customer_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)::integer AS shipments,
       SUM(i.amount) AS billed
FROM shipments AS s
LEFT JOIN invoices AS i ON i.shipment_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.customer_id
ORDER BY s.customer_id;

ambiguities.phrase: billed (the total invoice amount, NULL when nothing is billed)
ambiguities.readingChosen: Sum of every invoice on the customer's shipments, including invoices on cancelled shipments.

ambiguities.phrase: shipments (the number of shipments, including unbilled ones)
ambiguities.readingChosen: Every shipment row for the customer, whatever its status.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Exclude cancelled shipments from the count.

notes: Each of customers 1 to 6 has 40 shipments. Customers 7 and 8 have none and are excluded, as the ticket requires.
